links.outcome: Accuracy on post-knowledge-cutoff exam questions versus historical questions, to check contamination
links.effect: On 200 post-cutoff 2025 questions, accuracy matched historical averages (GPT-5 91.5%, Gemini 2.5 Pro 90.7%, GPT-4o 82.0%), so no material degradation on unseen questions.
links.quote: On 200 postknowledge cutoff questions from the 71st examination (2025), model accuracies were comparable to historical averages (eg, GPT-5 91.5%, 95% CI 86.8%-94.6%; Gemini 2.5 Pro 90.7%, 95% CI 85.8%-94.0%; GPT-4o 82.0%, 95% CI 76.1%-86.7%), indicating no material performance degradation on unseen questions.

unlisted_practices: Isolating the contribution of image input to multimodal model accuracy on an exam benchmark
Comparing model-human difficulty alignment by medical subfield

screen.reason: Evaluates cloud-hosted vision-language models on the Japanese National Examination for Clinical Laboratory Technicians. It is a benchmark study evaluating baseline model performance without testing specific organizational deployment practices or safeguards.
